prompt.zh-TW: 阿凱在整理海風衝浪店的資產負債表。下面這些項目各屬於資產、負債還是股東權益？把每張卡片放進正確的格子。
prompt.en: Kai is tidying up Seabreeze Surf’s balance sheet. Is each of these items an asset, a liability or equity? Put each card in the right box.

explanation.zh-TW: 應收帳款是客人還沒付的錢、存貨是還沒賣出的衝浪板、{{term:tm_gt8g4afe}}是修理衝浪板用、要用好幾年的機台，都是店擁有的資源，放資產。{{term:tm_a3p9y6kc}}是還沒付給供應商的貨款、短期借款是欠銀行的錢，放負債。{{term:tm_4c6v99nn}}是店自己賺來還沒分給股東的錢，放股東權益。
explanation.en: Trade receivables are money customers have not yet paid, inventories are boards not yet sold and {{term:tm_gt8g4afe}} is the board-repair rig the shop will use for years: all resources the shop holds, so assets. {{term:tm_a3p9y6kc}} are owed to suppliers and short-term borrowings are owed to the bank, so liabilities. {{term:tm_4c6v99nn}} are profit the shop earned and has not yet distributed to its shareholders, so equity.
